assertions.text: The response requires bootc status, read-only or image-managed /usr, and effective DNF persistence to be established before cleanup.
assertions.evidence: It mentions none of these checks.

assertions.text: The response distinguishes transient /usr changes from changes under /etc or /var that may persist.
assertions.evidence: It makes no persistence distinction between /usr, /etc, and /var.

assertions.text: The response does not present DNF autoremove as durable host cleanup until durable package mutation is verified.
assertions.evidence: It would execute autoremove after a candidate audit without verifying durable package mutation.

assertions.text: The response requires each effective persistent DNF cache root to be mapped to the approved filesystem before proposing cache cleanup.
assertions.evidence: A generic cache audit does not map each effective persistent cache root to the approved filesystem.
